### New
- **Pictures other mods draw on a display light the room too**, such as [Dream Displays Beam](https://github.com/XCraftTM/dreamdisplays-beam)'s screen and camera casts (Beam 0.2.1+). While such a picture is shown, its colors count instead of the display's own video, and the display lights even when it has no video.
- For mod authors: `dev.xcrafttm.ddlumen.api.LumenFrames.submit(display, rgba, width, height)` on the render thread for each new frame, `end(display)` when the picture is gone.

### Requirements
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ and Fabric API
- Dream Displays 1.10.6+ (client)
- Optional: Sodium + Iris, LambDynamicLights (1.20.1 and newer)

Client-only: servers only need Dream Displays itself.
